title: The New Sofa
text:
We have a new sofa. It is green and very soft. It is in the living room, next to the window. My cat likes to sleep on it.

Every evening, my family sits on the sofa. We watch TV and eat dinner. My father reads his book there. The sofa is our favorite place.

questions.text: What color is the new sofa?
What does the father do on the sofa?
Why is the sofa the family's favorite place?
options: It is comfortable and they spend time together there

questions.text: How does the writer probably feel about the cat?
options: Happy that the cat sleeps on the sofa

vocabulary.definition: a long seat for two or more people
not hard when you touch it
the room in a house where a family relaxes
the one you like the most

paragraph_translations: Temos um sofá novo. Ele é verde e muito macio. Está na sala de estar, perto da janela. Meu gato gosta de dormir nele.
Todas as noites, minha família senta no sofá. Nós assistimos TV e jantamos. Meu pai lê o livro dele ali. O sofá é nosso lugar favorito.
